extracted.name: Sweet French Toast
extracted.description: Make this sweet French toast recipe for a tasty treat that will satisfy your sweet tooth. Crumbled cornflakes add interesting texture to each bite!
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, or as needed
instruction_lines: Whisk milk, eggs, maple syrup, vanilla, and cinnamon together in a medium bowl. Add crumbled cornflakes and stir to combine.
Working in batches, soak 1/2 of the bread slices in the mixture for about 2 to 3 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Cook soaked bread slices in the hot skillet until dark golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes per side. Repeat to soak and cook remaining bread.
Sprinkle hot French toast with confectioners' sugar. Serve immediately.
